useful_god.rationale: Day Master Fire is strong; Earth balances the chart.

yogas.name: Gaja-Kesari
yogas.reason: Jupiter is in the 6th sign from the Moon; Gaja-Kesari needs the 1st, 4th, 7th or 10th.

yogas.name: Budha-Aditya
yogas.reason: Sun is in Aries and Mercury in Pisces; Budha-Aditya needs both in the same sign.

yogas.name: Chandra-Mangala
yogas.reason: Moon and Mars are both in Sagittarius.

yogas.name: Ruchaka
yogas.reason: Mars is in Sagittarius, neither its own sign (Aries, Scorpio) nor its exaltation sign (Capricorn).

yogas.name: Bhadra
yogas.reason: Mercury is in Pisces, neither its own sign (Gemini, Virgo) nor its exaltation sign (Virgo).

yogas.name: Hamsa
yogas.reason: Jupiter is in Taurus, neither its own sign (Sagittarius, Pisces) nor its exaltation sign (Cancer).

yogas.name: Malavya
yogas.reason: Venus is exalted in Pisces and in the 10th house from the Lagna, a kendra.

yogas.name: Sasa
yogas.reason: Saturn is in Taurus, neither its own sign (Capricorn, Aquarius) nor its exaltation sign (Libra).

yogas.name: Harsha
yogas.reason: The 6th house is Scorpio; its lord Mars is in the 7th house; Harsha needs the 6th, 8th or 12th.

yogas.name: Sarala
yogas.reason: The 8th house is Capricorn; its lord Saturn is in the 12th house.

yogas.name: Vimala
yogas.reason: The 12th house is Taurus; its lord Venus is in the 10th house; Vimala needs the 6th, 8th or 12th.

yogas.name: Neecha Bhanga
yogas.reason: Mercury is debilitated in Pisces; cancelled because (b) Mercury, lord of Virgo (Mercury's exaltation sign), is in a kendra (10th from the Lagna and 4th from the Moon); (c) Venus, exalted in Pisces, is in a kendra (10th from the Lagna and 4th from the Moon).

yogas.name: Sunapha
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Moon (Capricorn): none; 12th from the Moon (Scorpio): none (Sun, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Anapha
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Moon (Capricorn): none; 12th from the Moon (Scorpio): none (Sun, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Durudhara
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Moon (Capricorn): none; 12th from the Moon (Scorpio): none (Sun, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Kemadruma
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Moon (Capricorn): none; 12th from the Moon (Scorpio): none (Sun, Rahu and Ketu do not count); Kemadruma means both are empty. It is cancelled (Kemadruma Bhanga): Mars, Mercury and Venus in a kendra from the Moon (1st, 4th, 7th or 10th sign).

yogas.name: Vesi
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Sun (Taurus): Jupiter and Saturn; 12th from the Sun (Pisces): Mercury and Venus (Moon, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Vasi
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Sun (Taurus): Jupiter and Saturn; 12th from the Sun (Pisces): Mercury and Venus (Moon, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Ubhayachari
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Sun (Taurus): Jupiter and Saturn; 12th from the Sun (Pisces): Mercury and Venus (Moon, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Subha Kartari
yogas.reason: Natural benefics (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury) in the 2nd house: none; in the 12th: Jupiter. Subha Kartari needs both houses occupied by them (the Moon is not counted).

yogas.name: Papa Kartari
yogas.reason: Natural malefics (Sun, Mars, Saturn, Rahu, Ketu) in the 2nd house: none; in the 12th: Saturn. Papa Kartari needs both houses occupied by them (the Moon is not counted).

yogas.name: Parivartana
yogas.reason: Jupiter is in Taurus (ruled by Venus) and Venus is in Pisces (ruled by Jupiter).

yogas.name: Mangal Dosha
yogas.reason: Mars is 7th from the Lagna, 1st from the Moon and 10th from Venus; the dosha houses are the 1st, 2nd, 4th, 7th, 8th and 12th.

yogas.name: Kala Sarpa
yogas.reason: Planets lie on both sides of the Rahu–Ketu axis: Moon and Mars on one, Sun, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn on the other.

yogas.name: Amala
yogas.reason: Natural benefics (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury) in the 10th from the Lagna (Pisces): Venus and Mercury; in the 10th from the Moon (Virgo): none.

yogas.name: Dhana
yogas.reason: The 2nd lord Moon and the 11th lord Mars are linked: Moon and Mars are both in Sagittarius.

yogas.name: Dharma-Karmadhipati
yogas.reason: The 9th lord Saturn and the 10th lord Jupiter are linked: Saturn and Jupiter are both in Taurus.

yogas.name: Nakshatra Parivartana
yogas.reason: No two bodies occupy each other's nakshatras; nakshatra lords: Sun Ketu, Moon Venus, Mars Ketu, Mercury Mercury, Jupiter Moon, Venus Saturn, Saturn Sun, Rahu Rahu, Ketu Venus.
